BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEALED_CENSER.desc: At the start of combat, apply 1 [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-OPEN_CENSER.title: Open Censer
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-OPEN_CENSER.descri: At the start of combat, apply 1 [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies. After drawing your opening hand, choose 1 of the first 3 Plague cards in your draw pile to put into your hand.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-OPEN_CENSER.flavor: There is no putting it back.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-OPEN_CENSER.select: Choose a Plague card to put into your Hand.
